title: zujson 0.1.0
text: First release. json_parse(), json_parse_raw() json_parse_file() turn JSON R vectors lists. Arrays simplify atomic vectors elements share type, value’s type survives round trip; simplify = FALSE turns simplification entirely. json_write() json_write_raw() serialize R JSON text UTF-8 bytes. fully named vector list becomes object, anything else becomes array, length-1 atomic vectors unbox unless wrapped (). json_validate() reports whether input parses, without building result. json_parse_ndjson(), json_write_ndjson() json_write_ndjson_raw() handle application/x-ndjson (JSON Lines): one JSON value per line, parsed written type mappings single documents. Parsing always returns list records reports line number failure; data frame writes one object per row. pretty option, indented JSON contains newlines break framing. zujson_info() reports package version, vendored yyjson version nesting limit. Every failure raises condition inheriting zujson_error: zujson_parse_error, zujson_write_error, zujson_unsupported_type, zujson_depth_error, zujson_io_error zujson_arg_error. leading UTF-8 byte order mark ignored rather rejected, POSIXlt refused rather serialized 11 internal fields. yyjson 0.12.0 vendored src/vendor/yyjson; system library needed.
